name: social-copilot
alternateName: Local-First BYOK AI Chat Reply Assistant
description: Local-first, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) AI chat reply assistant browser extension (Manifest V3) and TypeScript SDK for Telegram Web, WhatsApp Web, and Slack Web. Generates 2-3 style-aware draft replies with outbound PII redaction, sender anonymization, multi-provider LLM failover, and strict human-in-the-loop confirmation.
featureList: Human-in-the-loop reply drafting (2-3 candidates across 5 reply styles and 4 thought-card directions) with zero default auto-sending
Platform DOM adapters for Telegram Web, WhatsApp Web, and Slack Web
Multi-provider BYOK LLM integration (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, NVIDIA, SiliconFlow) with primary/fallback failover and request deduplication
Outbound PII redaction, sender anonymization, and configurable context message/character budgets
Browser-local IndexedDB and chrome.storage persistence with ephemeral session-first API key storage (persistApiKey=false by default)
Sanitized diagnostic ring buffer and JSON profile/preference backup and restore
softwareRequirements: Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge supporting Manifest V3
Node.js >= 18.0.0 and pnpm >= 10.0.0 to build from source
User-supplied API key for a supported LLM provider
